verdict.rationale:
Braintrust evidences strong versioning and review capabilities for automations: datasets are 'versioned collections' (docs-31), experiments are 'immutable, comparable record of your eval runs' tracked over time (docs-27), and CI/CD integration runs evals on every PR to catch regressions (docs-2). However, there is no documented rollback mechanism (e.g., reverting a prompt/scorer/function to a prior version) anywhere in the evidence pack.
missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert functionality for prompts, scorers, or automations; independent/hands-on confirmation of version history UI.
